scope: Figma sources referenced by the Thepia Design System. Two community base libraries (structural) plus future Thepia override frames (identity).

ios-26-ui-kit.role: Mobile pattern & gesture grammar reference. Visual style is NOT inherited.

untitled-ui-free.role: Marketing & application/dashboard structural base. Override color, type, radius with Thepia primitives.

upgrade_path.adds: Mobile UI Kit (replaces iOS 26 bridging), full marketing/app kits, lifetime updates

thepia-com-brand.role: Authoritative source for primary brand color and typography pair

extracted_2026_05_28.tagline: Digital Products with a Personal Touch

thepia-tokens-figma.role: Future Thepia-branded Figma library with overridden tokens + signature components
thepia-tokens-figma.intent: Create a Thepia Figma library that subscribes to Untitled UI free + iOS 26 kit, overrides color/typography/radius tokens, adds signature illustration/motion examples. Lives separately from BUCHI.
